scoring_justification: Full recompute of the BTE accumulation curve requires running the complete DFT + ShengBTE workflow; this is infeasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox. Instead, we compare the agent's submitted accumulation CSV at selected mean free paths to hidden gold values derived from the paper's Figure 4, and verify monotonicity as a structural audit. Bulk kappa values are compared directionally against the paper-reported thresholds.

outputs.description: Thermal conductivity accumulation as a function of phonon mean free path at 300 K; at least 50 points, monotonic increasing. Evaluated with threshold-or-better: meeting or exceeding the hidden reference earns full credit; lower values reduce score proportionally to deficit.

Bulk thermal conductivity of pristine wurtzite AlN at 300 K, extracted from the asymptotic accumulation. Evaluated with threshold-or-better: meeting or exceeding the hidden reference earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: The accumulation CSV is the primary scored artifact. The bulk JSON is a compact summary. Both use threshold-or-better scoring: exceeding the paper's reference is not penalized; the reward degrades only for values below the threshold. The checker is being updated concurrently to implement directional threshold comparison for the CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference for accumulation CSV at selected mean free paths (0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10 µm) and bulk kappa thresholds (in-plane 380, cross-plane 320 W/m·K at 300 K).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Figure 4 and text. Figure 4 shows accumulation curves; text reports phonons with MFPs up to ~0.2 µm contribute ~50% of bulk, full accumulation around 3 µm, and bulk values estimated from the experimental comparison. The exact gold accumulation curve is modelled as a log-normal CDF consistent with those constraints, which also matches the paper's BTE trend.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Inline computation using cumulative distribution function of log-normal with median=0.2 µm, sigma=1.163 (derived from the 50% and full-accumulation points), scaled to kappa_max values 380 (in-plane) and 320 (cross-plane). The bulk thresholds are taken directly from the paper's reported in-plane ~380 and cross-plane ~320 W/m·K for the BTE prediction at 300 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The model parameters are chosen to reproduce the paper's stated key features (50% accumulation at ~0.2 µm, full accumulation at ~3 µm) and asymptotic values from the paper text, so the gold is consistent with the paper's data. The same model is used by the reference solve.sh, guaranteeing a correct submission reaches full reward.

steps.notes: Consists of monotonicity audit (0.1 sub-weight) and pointwise comparison at 5 MFPs (0.9 sub-weight)
Directional threshold: higher or equal to gold values earns full credit.
